notes: Two Escs 150 ms apart on an idle, empty composer open claude's Rewind picker ("Enter to continue · Esc to cancel"), which paints "❯ (current)" where the composer was; a third Esc closes it. Interrupt writes one Esc per turn for this reason, and the composer reading refuses the picker. Recorded with `HW_RECORD_INTERRUPT=1 go test ./pkg/chat -run RecordInterrupt` (pkg/chat/interrupt_record_test.go), interrupting through chat.Conversation.Interrupt: the real claude against a local Messages API, in /tmp/hw-rebake/rewind-picker with a fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (onboarding done, the directory trusted, permissions.defaultMode bypassPermissions, accepted) and a placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, so no account or tokens are involved.
